content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking for information on the number of Modbus clients that can connect at the same time to [product_name] operating as a Modbus server. I found this article, but it doesn't address [product_name]: [url]. Is there any information available for [product_name]?
[product_name] supports up to 8 static Modbus connections.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to know the maximum number of Modbus clients that can connect simultaneously to [product_name] as a Modbus server. They are unable to find specific details in [company_name]'s documentation. Another user clarifies that [product_name] allows up to 8 static Modbus clients, directly answering the question.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear documentation specifying the maximum number of Modbus client devices that can be simultaneously connected to [product_name] acting as a Modbus server.
